title: Authorization to Wire Closing and Funding Proceeds and the Disbursement Date
content:
## When funds may be wired

1. Funds for a Closing and Funding engagement are wired only while the closing status is signed or in rescission (read from the closing's system record).
2. Where rescission applies, funds may be wired only on or after the first funding day that follows the rescission expiration date. Count calendar days forward from the rescission expiration date, which is day zero; the wire date must be on or after the day reached by the count, the count being the method's funding days after rescission expiry.
3. The wire is released only when every prior-to-funding condition on the loan file is cleared or waived (the number of prior-to-funding conditions issued on the file that no clearance or waiver resolves is zero), the rate lock on the file is in force on the disbursement date (an expired lock must be relocked first) and, for a dry or mail-away closing, the signed package has passed review within the method's package review business days.
4. A funding request received by the method's funding request cutoff time on a business day is wired that day by the wire release cutoff time; a later request is wired the next business day.
5. When more than the method's longest signing-to-funding gap in business days passes between signing and funding, employment and credit verifications are redone before the wire.
6. The disbursement date is the wire date, and the first payment date is the first day of the month that falls the method's first-payment offset in months after the disbursement month.

## Rescission wait: boundary cases (hypothetical, 1-day count)

| Rescission expiration date (day zero) | Wire on | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| Monday | Monday | No |
| Monday | Tuesday | Yes, the day reached by the count |
| Monday | Wednesday | Yes |

## Funding request timing (hypothetical, cutoff 12:00)

| Request received | Wired |
|---|---|
| Tuesday 11:30 | Tuesday, by the wire release cutoff |
| Tuesday 12:30 | Wednesday |
